finding: After ATM-GOV-0173 closed successfully, runner-sync left .atm/history/evidence/ATM-GOV-0173.runner-sync-receipt.json and .atm/history/session-events/<laneId>/... untracked. A completed task should not leave the operator choosing between dirty worktree residue and unguided manual deletion.

Current source now has a runner-publication delivery slice that stages the task-owned runner receipt, and the frozen runner passes packages/cli/src/commands/git-governance/implementation/publication-delivery-slice.test.ts, tests/cli/post-close-zero-release-residue.test.ts, and tests/cli/pre-commit-evidence-context-parity.test.ts. These cover receipt inclusion, zero post-close release residue, and task-context recognition respectively.
followUp: Closed. Preserve the delivery-slice, post-close-zero-residue, and pre-commit evidence-context regressions. A newly reproduced orphan receipt or lane event must be recorded as a new incident with its exact runner-sync receipt and close bundle.
